description: This file defines the StreamFactory class implementing the StreamFactoryInterface from the PSR-7 standard, providing methods to create stream objects from various sources such as strings, files, and resources.

classes.name: StreamFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating StreamInterface instances from strings, files, or resources.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new stream from a string content.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from a file with specified mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing resource.
